snippet.title: BLOOD MALL: RETAPED - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: BLOOD MALL: RETAPED is a short first-person dinosaur horror game inspired by creature features of the 80s, and the works of Puppet Combo. Take control of a big game hunter-turned-rookie cop, sent to deal with a prehistoric threat that has turned the Dayton County Mall into a blood-soaked hell. BLOOD MALL: RETAPED will be available on Steam on April 22, 2026.
